name: models-200
notes: GET /v1beta/models is served from the local catalog, not from the upstream: the test registry holds mock-gemini-model as a Gemini-wire model (plus a non-Gemini model that must NOT be listed). recorded_response is the mock upstream's ListModels shape, documented for the wire, not consulted by this handler. No prices, display names or token limits are asserted: the catalog records none of those, so the response omits them.
